_about: Rules for apps/mobile/store, enforced by apps/mobile/test/store_listing_lint_test.dart. Limits verified 25 Sep 2026 (store/README.md). Lengths count UTF-16 code units (App Store Connect and Play Console count characters; for Telugu and Devanagari every vowel sign and virama is its own character, so this matches what the consoles show). Apple keywords are limited to 100 UTF-8 bytes as a conservative reading of the 100-character field.

disclaimer._about: Every description must carry the locale's 'not a medical device or an emergency service' line (PRD F9, REQ-SAFE-12). The same phrase is the only place the medical words below may appear.
disclaimer.en: Aura is not a medical device or an emergency service
disclaimer.te: Aura వైద్య పరికరం కాదు, అత్యవసర సేవ కూడా కాదు
disclaimer.hi: Aura कोई मेडिकल डिवाइस या इमरजेंसी सेवा नहीं है
disclaimer.te-Latn: Aura medical device kaadu, emergency service kooda kaadu
disclaimer.hi-Latn: Aura koi medical device ya emergency service nahi hai

banned_latin._about: Whole words, case-insensitive, all locales (Latin script appears in every listing). Health or treatment claims (PRD 06d 'calm, not treatment', Apple 1.4.1, Play health policy, Mental Healthcare Act / ASCI), App Review positioning (F9: never 'chat', 'anonymous', 'strangers'), and out-of-scope promises (22-out-of-scope: no therapy, AI, meditation videos, sleep stories, binaural beats).

banned_script._about: Substrings in Telugu and Devanagari (all locales): treatment/therapy/cure, medical, doctor, depression, anxiety, mental illness/health, sleep, meditation, chat, anonymous, strangers.

banned_title_words._about: App name / Play title only (Play metadata policy; Apple 2.3.7): no ranking, price or promotion words.

cross_store._about: An App Store listing never names Android or Google Play, and a Play listing never names Apple, iPhone or the App Store (Apple 2.3.10; Play metadata policy).

mirrors._about: Locales that must stay byte-identical (one English, Indian/British spelling; PRD 18-localization).
